cna.headline: Messi sets up Miami goal in first game since Argentina retirement
cna.teaser: Messi sets up Miami goal in first game since Argentina retirement
fullText: Sept 5 : Lionel Messi provided an assist in Inter Miami's 2-2 draw with Atlanta United in Florida on Saturday in the Argentine's first appearance since retiring from international duty earlier this week.
Messi, who captained Argentina to World Cup glory in 2022 and a runners-up finish in 2026, started for Miami in a match that kicked off more than 90 minutes late due to heavy rain and lightning.
The 39-year-old whipped in a corner that midfielder Casemiro headed past Atlanta goalkeeper Lucas Hoyos to put Miami ahead in the 32nd minute.

Miami's lead lasted only three minutes, however, as a sliding Casemiro blocked a cross that bounced off his keeper Dayne St. Clair and landed at the feet of Atlanta's Miguel Almiron, who guided it home to level.
Messi, who scored four goals and set up another in last weekend's 7-1 rout of CF Montreal, is joint top of the MLS scoring charts with 18 goals this season.
He had previously expressed doubts about continuing his playing career following the death of his father, Jorge, on August 8.

listening.title: Singapore Launches Smart Nation 2.0 Initiative
listening.transcript: Singapore has officially launched Smart Nation 2.0, with a renewed focus on digital safety and inclusivity. The government aims to reassure citizens that emerging tech will enhance, rather than complicate, their daily lives. By integrating artificial intelligence deeper into public services, the country hopes to boost overall efficiency while leaving no one behind in the digital transition.

economistArticle.title: The Jobs Apocalypse is Postponed: An AI Jobs Boom is Here
paras: For the past few years, the narrative surrounding artificial intelligence has been dominated by a single, terrifying premise: the machines are coming for your livelihood. Pundits warned that generative AI would trigger a swift and merciless labor market apocalypse, turning white-collar professionals into modern-day Luddites. Yet, as the initial dust settles, a highly counter-intuitive reality is emerging. Instead of wiping out employment, the technological vanguard is sparking an unprecedented hiring spree across multiple sectors.

The feared purge of white-collar workers has failed to materialise. Companies are discovering that while AI can draft a brief or debug a line of code, it still requires human oversight to yield useful results. Instead of firing workers, firms are actively upskilling their existing workforce to navigate these new digital tools. This has catalyzed a surge in demand for AI-literate talent, driving a boom in recruitment rather than a contraction.

Crucially, this wave of innovation is minting entirely new professions. Roles like prompt engineers, AI ethicists, and machine-learning integration specialists—occupations that did not exist in the corporate lexicon five years ago—are now highly coveted. Rather than cannibalising the labor market, AI is acting as an economic multiplier, forcing enterprises to expand their technical capabilities to remain competitive.

Moreover, this dynamic is particularly evident in tech-forward hubs like Singapore. Local enterprises and multinational corporations alike are pouring capital into AI development centres, incentivised by proactive government policies. This local trend mirrors the global shift: AI is not a job-killer, but a job-creator. The feared displacement is, at least for now, deferred by an overwhelming appetite for human-machine collaboration.
economistArticle.cn:
在过去几年中，围绕人工智能的叙述一直被一个可怕的前提所主导：机器正在夺走你的生计。专家们警告称，生成式AI将引发一场迅速而无情的劳动力市场末日，将白领专业人员变成现代的“卢德分子”。然而，随着最初的尘埃落定，一个高度违反直觉的现实正在显现。技术前沿非但没有消灭就业，反而正在多个行业引发一场空前的招聘热潮。

人们所担心的白领裁员潮并未兑现。企业发现，虽然AI可以起草简报或调试代码行，但它仍然需要人类的监督才能产生有用的结果。企业没有解雇员工，而是积极提升现有员工的技能，以驾驭这些新的数字工具。这催生了对具备AI素养人才的需求激增，推动了招聘的繁荣而非萎缩。

至关重要的是，这股创新浪潮正在创造全新的职业。像提示词工程师、AI伦理学家和机器学习整合专家这些五年前在企业词汇中根本不存在的职业，如今正受到热烈追捧。AI非但没有蚕食劳动力市场，反而充当了经济倍增器的角色，迫使企业扩大技术能力以保持竞争力。

此外，这种动态在新加坡等技术先进的枢纽尤为明显。在积极的政府政策激励下，本地企业和跨国公司都在向AI开发中心投入资金。这一本地趋势反映了全球性的转变：AI不是就业杀手，而是就业创造者。至少在目前，人们所担心的岗位被替代已被对人机协作的巨大胃口所推迟。

gems.s: Instead of wiping out employment, the technological vanguard is sparking an unprecedented hiring spree across multiple sectors.
gems.why: This sentence uses an 'Instead of [doing X], [Y is doing Z]' structure to contrast a common misconception with the actual reality, creating a strong rhetorical impact. 这个句子采用了“Instead of [doing X], [Y is doing Z]”（非但没有……，反而……）的结构，将普遍的误解与客观现实进行对比，创造出强烈的修辞效果。
